flags.message: Salience-version mismatch, all three candidates: each prediction froze context.band=baseline under context.salience_version=sal-v3, but the committed metrics/statpack.md 'Segment base rate by salience band' table is headed sal-v4. Per the evaluate prompt, segment_base_rate, brier_skill_score and base_rate_basis are omitted (null) on every evaluation in this cell. For re-derivation: `uv run fedcourts segment-anchors --term 2026 --salience-version sal-v3` prints the version-pinned baseline risk-set pool at 5.02% (n=12720, OT2017-OT2025) and the sal-v4 command prints the identical figure, consistent with docs/salience.md's statement that a sal-v3 cell's post-rebuild baseline is sal-v4's pool under sal-v3's name. If the intended policy is that superseded-but-registered versions take that pool, a re-grade or stamp rule could restore the skill column; the candidates themselves anchored on ~6.5% (n~13163) from the pre-rebuild sal-v3 pack, so their stated anchors no longer match any rendered table.
